name: SkipLine — 24/7 skip order desk
offer: Every skip enquiry answered 24/7, quoted from firm's postcode/size price book with road-permit logic, payment by SMS card link, drop booked — stop losing orders to answerphone and aggregator commission
buyer: Owner of independent UK skip-hire firm, 2-15 lorries, phone staffed 8-5 M-F, on findaskip/bestskiphire paying per-booking commission
channel_first10: Scrape findaskip.co.uk + bestskiphire.co.uk listings for outreach; FB groups 'Skip Hire UK'; UROC members. List-independent
timing_hypothesis: PSTN switch-off 31 Jan 2027 (~6mo out) forces analogue line change = adoption moment; voice AI ~$0.05-0.15/min 2026; 47% UK SME calls unanswered, 85% never call back

name: BayFiller — MOT recall engine
offer: Automated MOT-due texts to past customers via DVSA reg-plate expiry lookups, one-tap booking, no-show chasing, lapsed win-back — reported as MOTs booked and £ recovered
buyer: Owner of independent UK MOT test station, 1-4 bays, 30-80 MOTs/week, not dealer group
channel_first10: 692K list SIC 45.200 segment (DOWNGRADED) ; IGA member directory; FB 'Garage Owners UK'
timing_hypothesis: ~30% of MOTs happen after expiry; DVSA free reminder service (4M+ signups) inserting gov between garage and driver; 2026 wave of DIY MOT-reminder SaaS proves demand, none done-for-you

name: UnitFiller — storage enquiry desk
offer: Every storage enquiry answered <60s, quoted from live unit list, converted to reserved unit with deposit; unclosed quotes chased 24h/72h/7d
buyer: Owner/ops manager of independent UK self-storage, 1-3 sites, 100-600 units/site
channel_first10: SSA UK member directory outreach (list-independent); secondary 30K RE list as movers-referral angle
timing_hypothesis: SSA UK 2026 report (May 2026): occupancy fell to 75.1%, enquiry conversion fell across all channels — first demand fight in years; sub-1-hour responders convert 7x

name: CleanCollect — invoice chaser for cleaning contractors
offer: Invoices chased politely and relentlessly until paid — email+SMS in your name, day-7 call, statutory 8%+base interest auto-calculated, weekly cash report
buyer: MD of UK commercial cleaning contractor, 10-100 cleaners, £250k-£3m turnover, B2B 30-day terms, no credit controller
channel_first10: 692K list SIC 81210/81229 segment (DOWNGRADED); British Cleaning Council assocs; FB 'Cleaning Business Owners UK'
timing_hypothesis: Commercial Payments Bill entered Parliament 19 May 2026 — 60-day max terms, mandatory 8%+base interest; UK SMEs owed ~£26bn, avg £66,770/firm (Apr 2026, +10% YoY)

name: HaulPaid — POD-to-payment chaser
offer: Invoices out the day the job lands with POD attached (drivers upload by WhatsApp photo), chased until paid, POD disputes flagged 48h, statutory interest applied
buyer: MD of UK haulage firm, 5-50 trucks, general haulage/pallet work, no credit controller
channel_first10: RHA member directory; FB 'UK Haulage & Transport Owner Drivers'; Courier Exchange forums. List-independent
timing_hypothesis: Commercial Payments Bill targets shippers/3PLs hauliers invoice — fixed-sum right when disputes raised late = purpose-built leverage against 'missing POD' delays

name: ScaffBill — over-hire week recovery
offer: Bill every extra week scaffold stands: tracks agreed hire period, auto-raises weekly over-hire invoice, 'extend or book dismantle' client prompts, chases payment
buyer: Owner/contracts manager of UK scaffolding contractor, 5-50 operatives, X-weeks-then-weekly-rehire terms
channel_first10: Scaffolding Association + NASC member lists, free 'standing scaffold audit'; FB 'UK Scaffolders'. List-independent
timing_hypothesis: Commercial Payments Bill 8%+base mandatory interest; hypothesis: Building Safety Act remediation keeps scaffolds standing longer (verify)

name: PenFiller — kennel & cattery booking desk
offer: Calls answered during cleaning rounds (kennel-specific intake incl. vaccination status), deposits by card link, vaccination-expiry reminders, past-guest rebooking before school holidays
buyer: Owner of council-licensed UK boarding kennels/cattery, 20-100 pens, 2-8 staff
channel_first10: Public local-authority animal-boarding licence registers scraped for 10 counties; FB 'Kennel and Cattery Owners UK'; Pet Industry Federation. List-independent
timing_hypothesis: Voice AI cost collapse ~$0.05-0.15/min makes 24/7 answering affordable at kennel margins; PSTN switch-off Jan 2027; 47% SME calls unanswered

name: PestRenew — renewals and review engine
offer: Annual-contract renewal sequences 60/30/7d with e-sign + card, seasonal recall campaigns, every Google review answered <24h + post-job review requests
buyer: Owner of UK pest control firm, 1-10 technicians, BPCA/NPTA member, split contract/one-off revenue
channel_first10: BPCA 'Find a pest controller' directory + NPTA list, free 'renewal leak report'; FB 'Pest Control UK'. List-independent
timing_hypothesis: Review signals 16-20% of 2026 local ranking weight, response rate named factor; only ~5% of businesses reply; wasp season live now for recall campaigns

name: NightDrain — out-of-hours emergency desk
offer: 3am blocked-drain calls answered, priced from out-of-hours rate card, postcode-checked, card pre-authorised to kill tyre-kickers, booked — engineer only woken for confirmed paid jobs
buyer: Owner of UK drainage contractor, 2-10 vans, advertises 24/7 but diverts night phone to voicemail
channel_first10: @theoperator build-in-public series + outreach to Checkatrade drainage category scrape + NADC members
timing_hypothesis: PSTN switch-off kills analogue night-divert setups by Jan 2027; voice AI ~$0.05-0.15/min; crowded AI-receptionist field verified — wedge is out-of-hours-only triage + surge-rate quoting + card pre-auth

name: HireBack — off-hire chase and overdue-hire billing
offer: End-of-hire texts ('due back tomorrow — extend for £X/day or book return'), automatic continued-hire billing, escalation to loss invoice, deposits/damage by card link
buyer: Owner of independent UK tool & plant hire, 1-3 branches, counter/phone trade, paper tickets, nobody chasing overruns
channel_first10: HAE EHA member directory; FB 'Tool Hire UK'; Yell category scrape one region. List-independent
timing_hypothesis: Commercial Payments Bill mandatory interest on continued-hire charges; hypothesis: HAE-reported rise in unreturned kit 2025-26 (verify)
